name: job-search-os
description: Find verified jobs, prepare truthful resume drafts, and learn from application outcomes in a private workspace.

interface.shortDescription: Find live roles. Draft truthful resumes. Learn what works.
interface.longDescription: Job Search Harness helps a file-capable AI agent find and verify open roles, explain fit, research hiring contacts when enabled, save job descriptions, prepare resume drafts from verified facts, and learn from outcomes. Personal data stays in a separate private workspace. The candidate reviews every consequential decision and applies personally.
defaultPrompt: Start my Job Search Harness onboarding.
Help me set up my job search.
Show me how the Job Search Harness works.
